title: Janïr Tormenta Janïr Arupa
intro: Wasar pampankir mä jaqiw sartasïna, mä chʼamani markar chiqa yatichäwir kuttʼayañataki. Jaqenakajj wali suma edificionakampi ukat jan uñtasit chʼamanïtapatwa uñtʼatäpjjäna. Ukampis jachʼa jachʼa tukutapajj juykhuptayäna, janiw istʼañ munapkänti. Qhepatjja, mä jachʼa castigow jupanakar purtʼasïna, mä jiskʼa tama iyawsirinakarukiw qhespiyasïna.
clues: Nayarojj mä chʼamani jaqenakaruw khitapjjetäna, jupanakajj jachʼa pampanakanwa jakasipjjäna, wali chʼamanïpjjatap laykuw uñtʼatäpjjäna.
Markajasti yaqha jach'a marka qhipatwa jutäna, uka markax t'unjatäxänwa.
Jupanakajj wali suma edificionakanïpjjänwa ukat jachʼa torrenakwa lurapjjäna.
Mä Diosar yupaychañatakiw jawstʼayäta, ukampis janiw idolonakap jaytañ munapkänti.
Mä jachʼa castigow jupanakar purtʼäna, nayamp chik iyawsirinakarukiw qhespiyäna.
Nayasti Aad sutimp uñt'at ch'aman markar khithatätwa.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
